identity_policy: Only explicit mapping IDs are used, prefixed KAGGLE_Voice: unless already prefixed. Filename numbers are not participants. Missing IDs exclude recordings from participant-disjoint modelling.
diagnosis_policy: Only Healthy=0 and Parkinson/Parkinsons/PD=1 ancestor folder labels (case-insensitive). Other or conflicting folders have missing diagnosis and target. RBD is not a positive label.
stage_policy: Optional mapping disease_stage is retained verbatim. Otherwise healthy is Not applicable, all others Unknown; confirmed PD is not assumed early-stage.

processing.pitch_voicing_rule: pyin voiced flag, finite F0/probability, probability >= 0.8, frame RMS > max(1e-5, 5% of maximum frame RMS)
processing.voiced_fraction_denominator: all centered analysis frames; missing if pitch estimation fails
processing.short_or_silent_policy: Retain metadata and hashes, leave acoustic features missing.
processing.outlier_policy: No clipping; nonfinite feature values become missing, never fabricated zero.

jitter_shimmer.reason: No validated glottal pulse extraction is performed. Frame-level F0 and RMS cannot provide pitch-period jitter or cycle-amplitude shimmer. These columns are intentionally omitted, not filled with zeros.

source_integrity.decoded_hash: SHA256 of ASCII decoded-float32-le-v1:sample_rate:frames:channels plus newline followed by original-rate, interleaved-channel little-endian float32 decoded samples; before mono conversion/resampling
source_integrity.duplicate_policy: All copies retained; these are evidence of recording duplication, not participant identity. Parent cleaning must prevent duplicate-content leakage.
